description: The file is an HTML document that serves as the user interface for a web-based database viewer application. It contains the structure, styles, and scripts needed to display and interact with databases, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and updates the sidebar UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by reloading from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database's tables list.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from the selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table given the data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a table cell, with special handling for objects and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
